subject: SageWire LlamaIndex embedding runtime integration — mutual action plan
messages:
From: Priya Nair <priya@sagewire.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alexg@sagewire.ai>
Date: 2027-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exploring LlamaIndex embedding runtime integration with Redwood

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking a look at this. I lead partnerships at SageWire and we build an embeddings-first knowledge graph product that many customers surface via LlamaIndex. We've had a few active customers ask for a tighter runtime integration with Redwood so they can route queries to a hosted Redwood endpoint while keeping prompt orchestration in LlamaIndex.

High-level ask: can Redwood support a lightweight embedding/runtime binding so that LlamaIndex can call Redwood for token generation and for embedding compute with predictable latency and attribution? Key asks from our side:
- Small SDK/adapter (Python) that plugs into LlamaIndex's runtime hooks
- Server-side routing configuration for model variants and a simple API key flow
- Trace propagation (request IDs) so we can reconcile tokens and costs

If this sounds feasible, we'd love to run a short PoC and propose a mutual action plan. Proposed next steps from SageWire:
1) Share a one-page SOW + SOC2 summary
2) Provide a sample repo (LlamaIndex adapter prototype) and API samples
3) Kickoff call next week to align scope and timeline

Would you loop in your partnerships and runtime folks? Alex (cc'd) will be my engineering lead on this.

Best,
Priya
Priya Nair
Head of Partnerships, SageWire
priya@sagewire.ai
[www.sagewire.ai]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Priya Nair <priya@sagewire.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring LlamaIndex embedding runtime integration with Redwood

Hi Priya — great to meet you and thanks for the clear ask. I'm on the partnerships / integrations team and excited to explore. Copying Vanessa (partnerships lead) and Aditya (runtime eng) to scope feasibility. Marissa on the ISV enablement side — she'll coordinate docs and certification.

Quick responses to your bullets:
- SDK/adapter: that's reasonable; we prefer a thin client that uses our standard REST/HTTPS endpoints. We can provide a sample Python shim for LlamaIndex to call.
- Routing/config: yes — our routing policies support model variants and region pinning. We'll work through auth flows (API key vs short-lived tokens).
- Trace propagation: we do support request-id headers and can surface token-level cost attribution to partners as part of the integration.

Next steps I propose from Redwood:
1) Share a short mutual action plan template and a desired kickoff week (we have capacity week of 10/25)
2) We'll need your SOW + SOC2 summary and a sample repo to evaluate; can you attach those?
3) Aditya, can you do an initial technical read and propose any runtime constraints (quantization, seq length, batching) after you get the sample?

Priya — can we do a 30-min call on Tue 10/26 at 10am PT? If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com

Hi Mateo — thanks for the quick reply and the proposed cadence. Attaching the initial SOW and our SOC2 summary, plus a small sample repo that demonstrates the LlamaIndex hook we expect to use. The SOW is deliberately short — scope and pricing are preliminary.

Highlights from the SOW (sagewire_sow_v1.pdf):
- PoC (4 weeks): adapter + sample integration tests, joint runbook for routing and fallbacks
- Production pilot (3 months): enablement, monitoring dashboard, 2 model variants (cost / latency tradeoffs)
- Revenue model: referral + usage credit (we're open to Redwood's preferred commercial structure)

Attachments:
- sagewire_sow_v1.pdf (SOW draft, 6 pages) [Attachment]
- sagewire_soc2_summary.pdf (one-page SOC2 summary) [Attachment]
- sagewire_api_sample.zip (sample adapter + README) [Attachment]

We can do Tue 10/26 10am PT — Alex and I will be on the call. I'll also share a short HubSpot record after this email.

Thanks,
Priya
